CustomField.description: Flow-managed checkbox. True only when the Case has Document_Checklist__c records (Case__c = Case.Id) and all of them have Status = Final; false when none are linked. Case_Completion_Update_Flow separately treats a Case with no exit-doc rows as passing the 100% gate. Maintained by Doc_Checklist_Completion_Sync_Flow. Acts as the gate to reach 100% completion.
CustomField.label: All Exit Docs Final
